data.case_title: Offer to convert fixed-term contract to permanent position (Beispiel Pflegeheim am Park)
data.title: Offer to make your fixed-term contract permanent
data.summary: Beispiel Pflegeheim am Park gGmbH offers to continue Tarek Beispiel's fixed-term employment as a nurse (Pflegefachkraft), which ends on 30 June 2027, as an unlimited full-time contract from 1 July 2027 on unchanged terms. The employer asks for a decision within 6 working days of the letter's date, otherwise the position will be filled otherwise.
data.explanation: Your employer is offering to turn your fixed-term contract into a permanent (unbefristet) one from 1 July 2027, with the same conditions as before. You need to tell them whether you accept within the short deadline shown by the app, counted in working days (Monday–Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter's date. If you miss it, they say they will plan the position with someone else, so it's worth replying promptly even informally, then confirming in writing. This is good news for your job security if you want to stay; no legal advice is needed unless you have concerns about the terms.

key_facts.quote: Ihr befristeter Arbeitsvertrag als Pflegefachkraft endet am 30.06.2027.

key_facts.label: Proposed permanent contract start date
key_facts.quote: Wir bieten Ihnen an, ihn ab dem 01.07.2027 unbefristet fortzusetzen, zu unveränderten Bedingungen in Vollzeit.

key_facts.label: Response deadline
key_facts.quote: Ihre Entscheidung erbitten wir binnen 6 Werktagen ab Datum dieses Schreibens;

items.title: Reply to the offer to make your contract permanent
items.action: Tell your employer whether you accept the offer to continue your employment on an unlimited (unbefristet) full-time contract from 1 July 2027.
items.consequence: If you don't respond in time, the employer says they will plan the position with someone else instead.
